resources.string: Connect to a computer running DeepSeek Harness
1. On the computer open DSH → the “DDeck” panel.\n2. Turn on Tailscale on both Mac and phone (same tailnet).\n3. Tap “New code” and scan the QR. The code lives for five minutes.
Scan the QR code from the computer
Open the DDeck panel on the computer and tap “New code”.

1. On the computer open DSH → the “DDeck” panel.
2. Turn on Tailscale or your own server (see docs/RELAY).
3. Tap “New code” and scan the QR.

The code lives for five minutes. An old QR will not work — get a fresh one.
If the error mentions a fingerprint: tap “Forget” on the old computer and pair again with a fresh QR.\nOn timeout, check that the Mac is awake, DSH is running and Tailscale/your server is reachable.
Long-press the version for a bug-report diagnostic. Never share QR/codes/tokens.
